description:
Initialization only: Tabu Search.
- Initial Order: Ascending task IDs.
- Search: Select best pairwise swap per pass (including non-improving moves).
- Tabu & Aspiration: Forbid swapped task pair for 3 iterations; allow tabu move if it improves global best.
- Termination: Stop when no eligible move remains or evaluation limit is reached; return best issued trial.
